text:
maria: Quick heads up — I'm going to bump replicas on `inference-api` in eu-west from 3 -> 5 and loosen the rollout to reduce evictions for warm pods. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/458

maria: Changes in the PR:
```
- replicas: 3 -> 5
- strategy:
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 25%
- readinessProbe: http_get /ready -> initialDelaySeconds: 10
- startupProbe: http_get /health -> failureThreshold: 30
- resources.requests.cpu: 200m -> 300m
```

david: Thanks — did you run the tf plan for the autoscaler bump? We need to sync HPA min/max.

maria: yes, did local `terraform plan` on the eu-west workspace. HPA min is 2 max 10, I set replicaTarget to 5 so it's within bounds. plan link: https://ci.redwood/run/987

sarah: @maria what's the reason for increasing cpu requests? previous OOMs? any perf traces?

maria: saw more cpu throttling on p95 during long context calls. raising request avoids CPU throttling spikes during startup.

priya: small nit: maxUnavailable 25% might cause 1 of 5 to be taken down — fine for canary but double-check readiness to avoid flapping. consider `maxUnavailable: 20%` or `1`.

maria: good point. happy to set `maxUnavailable: 1` to be safer. updated PR.

david: Also remind folks: secrets path changed last week from `/secrets/kv/inference` -> `/secrets/apps/inference` — will this PR update the deployment mount? otherwise pods will fail to find model keys.

maria: yes, I updated the k8s secret projection to new path and synced the terraform secret resource. snippet in PR:
```
env:
  - name: MODEL_KEY_PATH
    value: "/secrets/apps/inference/model_key"
volumeMounts:
  - mountPath: "/etc/keys"
    name: model-keys
```

sarah: do we need a migration step for existing nodes? vault agent picks up new path in runtime, but old pods might still read old env var.

maria: rollout will restart pods. I added a post-deploy smoke test in the pipeline that checks `/ready` and tries a small embed call.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #458 — plan shows 2 modified resources, 1 updated k8s deployment

priya: LGTM from me if deploy-bot is happy. @david want to do a quick review on HPA/hpa-metrics config?

david: reviewing now, will leave comments. If no blockers I'll approve in the next 20m.

maria: thanks all — planning to merge at 10:30 UTC and monitor latency/cost dash for 1hr. ping me if you see >5% error or any unexpected restarts :eyes:

sarah: thanks. will keep an eye on logs and APM. :thumbsup:

maria: (after merge) merged & applying; kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-api -n eu-west

deploy-bot: deployment/inference-api rollout succeeded — 5/5 updated

david: quick check — pods mounted the new `/etc/keys` and smoke test passed. closing thread.
